name: gmx-cypher roles
about: The role layer over Morpheus's tokens.json (copied verbatim): where gmx-cypher's colour roles differ from Morpheus (docs/design-contract.md §2, T159). Generated into tokens.css with tokens.json by scripts/tokens.ts.

tokens.name: state
tokens.usage: UI state, as an ink fill: the selected toggle, the primary action, the active tab. Never data.

tokens.name: state-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `state`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Morpheus's primary action, here in ink: coral is a group's hue.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `primary`.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: The focus ring, in ink.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors, failed and armed destructive actions only. At least 0.10 apart in OKLab from every tone, ring and primary.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `destructive`.

tokens.name: ramp-0
tokens.usage: Ordered series (time, ξ, RMSF), first stop; interpolated in OKLCH. At least 3:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: ramp-1
tokens.usage: Ordered series, second stop.

tokens.name: ramp-2
tokens.usage: Ordered series, third stop.

tokens.name: ramp-3
tokens.usage: Ordered series, last stop.

tokens.name: bond
tokens.usage: Bonds between atoms outside every group, in the structure views.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The rim mixed into an atom outside every group.

tokens.name: atom-c
tokens.usage: An atom outside every group, by element (C): warm greys, so the groups' hues are the only colour in a structure.

tokens.name: atom-h
tokens.usage: An atom outside every group, by element (H): warm greys, so the groups' hues are the only colour in a structure.

tokens.name: atom-o
tokens.usage: An atom outside every group, by element (O): warm greys, so the groups' hues are the only colour in a structure.

tokens.name: atom-n
tokens.usage: An atom outside every group, by element (N): warm greys, so the groups' hues are the only colour in a structure.

tokens.name: atom-s
tokens.usage: An atom outside every group, by element (S): warm greys, so the groups' hues are the only colour in a structure.

tokens.name: atom-p
tokens.usage: An atom outside every group, by element (P): warm greys, so the groups' hues are the only colour in a structure.

tokens.name: atom-x
tokens.usage: An atom outside every group, by element (X; X: any other): warm greys, so the groups' hues are the only colour in a structure.
